h: Arsène Wenger reportedly considering challenge to Infantino for FIFA presidency
p: Former Arsenal manager Arsène Wenger is reportedly weighing a bid to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency, with UEFA figures said to be urging him to run before the 18 November deadline.
body: Former Arsenal manager Arsène Wenger is reportedly considering a bid to challenge Gianni Infantino in the upcoming FIFA presidential election.

According to reports on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, key football figures, including leaders within European governing body UEFA, have been lobbying the 77-year-old Frenchman to stand before the nomination deadline of 18 November, and a decision is expected this week. European officials are said to have grown disillusioned with Infantino after controversies over FIFA's commercial plans.

Wenger managed Arsenal for 22 years, winning three Premier League titles and seven FA Cups, and has been FIFA's chief of global football development since November 2019. Infantino has led FIFA since 2016 and has overseen the expansion of the World Cup to 48 teams.
more: Wenger is weighing a run against Infantino.
UEFA figures are reportedly lobbying him.
The deadline for candidates is 18 November.
